create_model_hub_mixin: create a Python class inheriting from ModelHubMixin to integrate any ML framework with the Huggingface Hub
save_model_pretrained: save a model's weights and configuration to a local directory using the save_pretrained method
load_model_pretrained: download and instantiate a model from the Huggingface Hub using the from_pretrained class method
push_model_to_hub: upload a model checkpoint and configuration to a Huggingface Hub repository using push_to_hub
generate_model_card: generate a Huggingface ModelCard with metadata and template for a model repository
